# PRUDEV II — BGE Facilitation & Accountability Report Template
**Promoting Rural Development II (PRUDEV II) — Implemented by GOPA Pro & GIZ**

## Purpose & Overview
This template provides the mandatory accountability and verification cover document for Business Growth Experts (BGEs) leading the **Business Continuity Planning (BCP) & Operational Planning** assignment with assigned MSMEs / Agro-processors (Work Order: `fi_mobilisation_bcp` / `agro_biz_continuity`).

### Core Design Principles
1. **Zero Redundant Data Entry**: All MSME metadata (name, code, sector, location, contact, baseline diagnostic turnover, employee counts) and BGE details (name, code, contact) are auto-populated by the system.
2. **Ironclad Field Verification**: Captures exact session dates, hours on-site, physical presence at MSME premises (including GPS stamp), and enterprise staff participants.
3. **The Acid Test Focus**: Replaces vague narratives with one concrete operational change the MSME owner committed to executing immediately.
4. **Deliverable Compliance**: Attaches directly to the MSME's 3-page Business Continuity Plan to substantiate the BGE's Work Order deliverable and timesheet for payment approval.

---
